strings.accessory_noroom: No room in your inventory to take that off
strings.hint_ring: Put it in a Ring slot. Two of the same ring both count.
strings.hint_belt: Put it in the Belt slot.
strings.look_boneband: A band of polished bone, bound with a strip of leather.
strings.look_copperring: A plain copper ring set with a chip of amber.
strings.look_ironring: A heavy iron ring, its inside smeared with blood.
strings.look_silverring: A silver ring as cold as the glands it was cooled in.
strings.look_blackmetalring: A black metal ring stitched through with needle wire.
strings.look_eitrring: A silver ring that hums with refined eitr.
strings.look_leatherbelt: A sturdy belt of deer hide and leather scraps.
strings.look_trollhidebelt: A thick troll hide belt with a bronze buckle.
strings.look_loxbelt: A broad belt of lox pelt, reinforced with black metal.
strings.count_noroom: Make room in your inventory first
strings.cfg_general__lock_configuration_help: Server administrators control inventory layout and equipment settings.
strings.cfg_1_inventory__enabled_help: Master switch for Mantle: the bigger grid, the labeled slots, the coin purse, the key ring, the backpacks and the brown look. Off: the game's own inventory, its 8 x 4 grid (plus rows bought from the trader) and its wood look; every other Mantle setting is ignored. Items in the slots move into the grid, what does not fit is dropped at your feet.
strings.cfg_1_inventory__inventory_width_help: Columns of the inventory grid. The game has 8; the hotbar keys stay 1 to 8. Warning: items in columns beyond 8 are lost if Mantle is removed, so empty them first.
strings.cfg_1_inventory__inventory_rows_help: Rows of the inventory grid. The game has 4; rows bought from the trader come on top of this. 0 leaves only two cells, your hands (hotbar keys 1 and 2); a worn backpack's cells continue after them. Lowering it drops what no longer fits at your feet. Items in rows beyond the game's are dropped at your feet if Mantle is removed.
strings.cfg_1_inventory__base_carry_weight_help: How much a player carries before being over-encumbered, before Megingjord and other effects add to it. The game has 300. The world's carry weight modifier still scales it.
strings.cfg_1_inventory__keep_on_death_help: The slot groups whose items stay with you when you die instead of going into your grave, comma separated (e.g. Food, Ammo): Gear (head, chest, legs, back; feet too while laid out), Backpack, Utility, Trinket, Ring, Belt, Food, Mead, Ammo, Tacklebox. What you wore of them is worn again when you wake. A backpack's or tacklebox's own cells, the coin purse, the key ring and the grid follow the game's rules. None: everything goes to the grave. Replaces Keep Slots On Death: an old setting that was on is carried over once, as every group.
strings.cfg_2_slots__equipment_slots_help: Head, Chest, Legs and Back slots, and a Feet slot for EliteEquipment's boots while its Separate Boots is on. Armor you wear sits in its slot; drop a piece on its slot to wear it, drag it out to take it off.
strings.cfg_2_slots__auto_equip_help: Gear in the Gear tab is worn. Right click armor, a cape, a utility or a trinket in an open chest to wear it (the piece in its slot moves to a free cell of your inventory first; with none, nothing changes); a piece that lands in its slot any other way is put on too. A worn piece taken off moves into a free cell of your inventory; with none it comes off in its slot and stays off until you put it on again; it is never dropped. A piece that breaks while worn stays in its slot and goes back on once repaired. Off: a piece that lands in its slot unworn stays unworn, and a right click in a chest does nothing.
strings.cfg_2_slots__instant_equip_help: Weapons, tools, shields and armor go on and come off at once, with no equipping bar. Off: the game's equip time.
strings.cfg_2_slots__utility_slots_help: Utility slots (belts, the wishbone, the wisplight...) when Slots Per Group is 0. Every utility item in a slot is worn at once, so up to this many work together. 0: none, the game's single utility item.
strings.cfg_2_slots__trinket_slot_help: A Trinket slot under the utilities. The trinket in it is the one you wear (the game wears one at a time); drop a trinket on it to wear it, drag it out to take it off.
strings.cfg_2_slots__backpack_slot_help: A Backpack slot. Mantle's backpacks are worn in it (see 4. Backpacks); it also holds a backpack from another mod (any item whose prefab name contains "backpack", or one listed in Backpack Items), but does not equip those.
strings.cfg_2_slots__ring_slots_help: Ring slots in the Gear tab, 0 to 2. A ring slot takes only a ring (an item the accessory registry, Mantle.Accessories.yml, tags as one); the rings in the slots give their bonuses together, and two identical rings give double. 0: no ring slot.
strings.cfg_2_slots__belt_slot_help: A Belt slot in the Gear tab, taking only a belt (an item Mantle.Accessories.yml tags as one: Mantle's belts and the Megingjord). The belt in it gives its bonus. Off: no slot, and the Megingjord is a utility item as in the game.
strings.cfg_2_slots__backpack_items_help: More prefab names the Backpack slot accepts, comma separated.
strings.cfg_2_slots__slots_per_group_help: Older setting kept for existing profiles: 1 to 5 sets the number of Utility slots; 0 uses Utility Slots instead. Food, Mead and Ammo have their own settings.
strings.cfg_2_slots__food_slots_help: Food slots (0 to 5) when Food Slots Follow Eating is off. 0: no Food slots, no Food row and no food square on the bar.
strings.cfg_2_slots__food_slots_follow_eating_he: As many food slots as foods a player can eat at once: the Food Slots setting of the FeastMaster mod when that mod is installed, otherwise the game's 3 (at most 5). Slots Per Group does not change food slots.
strings.cfg_2_slots__mead_slots_help: Slots for meads and other drinks and potions (0 to 5). 0: no Mead slots, no Mead row and no mead squares on the bar.
strings.cfg_2_slots__ammo_slots_help: Slots for arrows, bolts, missiles and bait (0 to 5). 0: no Ammo slots and no Ammo row.
strings.cfg_2_slots__coin_purse_help: A purse slot on the Gear tab: coins you pick up go into it, traders take coins from it as from anywhere in the inventory.
strings.cfg_2_slots__food_key_help: Outside the inventory, with no hammer, hoe or cultivator in hand: eats every food in the Food slots that can be eaten now, left to right. Per player.
strings.cfg_2_slots__mead_slot_1_key_help: Outside the inventory, with no hammer, hoe or cultivator in hand: drinks the mead in Mead slot 1 (counted left to right), if it can be drunk now. While this key's modifiers are held (Left Alt by default), the number keys use no hotbar item. Per player.
strings.cfg_2_slots__mead_slot_2_key_help: Outside the inventory, with no hammer, hoe or cultivator in hand: drinks the mead in Mead slot 2 (counted left to right), if it can be drunk now. While this key's modifiers are held (Left Alt by default), the number keys use no hotbar item. Per player.
strings.cfg_2_slots__mead_slot_3_key_help: Outside the inventory, with no hammer, hoe or cultivator in hand: drinks the mead in Mead slot 3 (counted left to right), if it can be drunk now. While this key's modifiers are held (Left Alt by default), the number keys use no hotbar item. Per player.
strings.cfg_2_slots__mead_slot_4_key_help: Outside the inventory, with no hammer, hoe or cultivator in hand: drinks the mead in Mead slot 4 (counted left to right), if it can be drunk now. While this key's modifiers are held (Left Alt by default), the number keys use no hotbar item. Per player.
strings.cfg_2_slots__mead_slot_5_key_help: Outside the inventory, with no hammer, hoe or cultivator in hand: drinks the mead in Mead slot 5 (counted left to right), if it can be drunk now. While this key's modifiers are held (Left Alt by default), the number keys use no hotbar item. Per player.
strings.cfg_3_key_ring__key_ring_help: A key ring button right of the coin purse. Click it for a round pop-up with a cell for every key in Key Items you have found: keys you pick up or take from a chest, grave or trader go there first, and doors still find them. Off: keys go to the grid; keys on the ring move to the grid, what does not fit is dropped at your feet.
strings.cfg_3_key_ring__key_items_help: The keys the ring holds, as prefab names, comma separated, one ring cell each in this order. The default is the game's six keys, from the Black Forest to the Ashlands.
strings.cfg_3_key_ring__key_stack_help: How many of one key stack in one cell, on the ring and everywhere else (chests too), for every key in Key Items. The game has 1; keys of different world levels never stack. With OpenKeep installed, an OpenKeep.Stacks.yml entry for a key wins. Applies even with Key Ring or Mantle's master switch off, so turning those off never cuts a stack of keys. Warning: lowering it, or removing Mantle, cuts bigger stacks of keys when they load, and the rest is lost.
strings.cfg_4_backpacks__backpacks_help: Mantle's backpacks, one per biome from the Deerhide Satchel to the Moosehide Pack (their slots, carry weight, stations and costs are in Mantle.Backpacks.yml). Put one in the Backpack slot, by dropping it there or right clicking it, to wear it: it hangs on your back and adds its slots to the bottom of the grid and its carry weight. Taking it off moves what its slots hold into free cells and drops what does not fit at your feet. Off: none can be crafted and a worn one adds nothing. Needs 2. Slots / Backpack Slot.
strings.cfg_4_backpacks__backpack_portal_pass_he: Items in the slots of a backpack marked portal: true in Mantle.Backpacks.yml (the Moosehide Pack) go through portals even when the game forbids them (ores, metals, eggs...). Everything else in the inventory still follows the game's rule.
strings.cfg_4_backpacks__show_worn_backpack_help: Your worn backpack hangs on your back where every player sees it. Off: it is invisible, to you and to everyone else, and still gives its slots and carry weight. Your own choice, not synced from the server.
strings.cfg_5_look__slot_labels_help: The name of each slot on the slot while it is empty.
strings.cfg_5_look__slot_icons_help: A drawing of what belongs in each slot on the slot while it is empty, centered when Slot Labels is off.
strings.cfg_5_look__panel_look_help: The Meadworks wood look of the inventory panels, their cells, the equipment panel and the crafting panel (art and Timber settings are in the Crucible.UI config, section Look). Off: the game's own wood.
strings.cfg_5_look__weight_under_minimap_help: Armor and carry weight in boxes in a column right of the minimap, followed by Elite Creatures Reborn's world tier when it is installed. The minimap and the status effects move a little left to make room.
strings.cfg_5_look__crafting_panel_width_help: Extra width for the crafting panel and the panel above it (your name, skills, trophies, PvP), in interface units (the game's panels are 570): a wider recipe list and description. They grow to the left, never into the inventory's panels (so on a narrow screen they get what fits). 0: the game's width. Default 100, as in PackPanel.
strings.cfg_5_look__crafting_panel_height_help: Extra height for the crafting panel, in interface units (the game's panel is 650): a longer recipe list and more room for the description. It grows downward, never past the bottom of the screen. 0: the game's height.
strings.cfg_5_look__food_and_mead_bar_help: In the bottom-left corner of the screen, under your health: a food square with the Food Key over it, then a square per Mead slot that has a key, showing its mead with its Mead Slot key over it.
strings.cfg_6_tacklebox__tacklebox_help: A Tacklebox slot right of the key ring button, and Mantle's five tackleboxes, from the Driftwood Tacklebox to the Timberwood Tacklebox (their cells, stations and costs are in Mantle.Tackleboxes.yml). Put a box in the slot, by dropping it there or right clicking it, then click it there to open it (Shift click picks it up to move it): a pop-up under the slot panel with its cells. Bait you pick up or take from a chest goes into it first, the fishing rod takes its bait from it first, and right clicking a bait in it fishes with that bait. Taking the box out moves what its cells hold into free cells and drops what does not fit at your feet. Off: no slot, none can be crafted.
strings.cfg_6_tacklebox__tackle_items_help: Items a tacklebox takes besides fishing bait, as prefab names, comma separated (chum, another mod's lures). Empty: bait only.
